cluster.fsid.description: Unique 128-bit UUID identifying this Ceph cluster. Must be generated once per cluster.

items.description: Initial monitor hostnames or IP addresses participating in the bootstrap quorum (comma-separated in config, but provided as list here).

cluster.mon_initial_members.description: List of monitor names/IPs that form the initial quorum members during cluster bootstrap.

items.description: Any monitor hostname or IP address reachable by clients or other daemons.

cluster.mon_host.description: List of monitor addresses for client and OSD connectivity. Should include all monitors.

network.public_cidr.description: CIDR subnet for the public (client-facing) network (e.g., '192.168.1.0/24').

network.cluster_cidr.description: CIDR subnet for the cluster (replication/internal) network (e.g., '10.0.0.0/24').

security.auth_cluster_required.description: Authentication required for cluster daemons (e.g., cephx, none).

security.auth_service_required.description: Authentication required for services (e.g., cephx, none).

security.auth_client_required.description: Authentication required for clients (e.g., cephx, none).

logging.log_file.description: Path to log file (supports $cluster and $name variables).

logging.log_to_stderr.description: Whether to emit logs to stderr in addition to the log file.

logging.err_to_stderr.description: Whether to emit error-level logs to stderr even if log_to_stderr is false.

logging.log_std_level.description: Log level for stderr/stdout output (e.g., debug, info, warn, error).

mon.clock_drift_allowed.description: Maximum allowed clock drift between monitors (in seconds) before warnings.

mon.clock_drift_warn_backoff.description: Time (seconds) to back off from issuing clock drift warnings after one has been raised.

mon.lease.description: Duration (seconds) of a leader lease in the monitor quorum.

mon.lease_renew_interval.description: Interval (seconds) at which the leader renews its lease.

mon.lease_ack_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for lease acknowledgment before triggering quorum re-election.

mon.quorum_size.description: Target quorum size (must be odd, e.g., 1, 3, 5). Adjusted automatically for cluster size if omitted.

mon.quorum_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) allowed between monitor communication before declaring quorum lost.

mon.allow_pool_delete.description: Whether to allow pool deletion via CLI. Enable with caution.

services.description: Additional per-service (e.g., mon, osd, mds, mgr) override sections. Keys are service section names like 'mon.a', 'mgr.x', etc.
